content: Hey! How was your day? Still swamped at work or did you finally get some rest?
Hey you  Still working late. Got home just now. How about you?
I missed you today. I kept thinking about our plans for the weekend. I can't wait to see you in person.
Me too. Seriously, it gives me something to look forward to. I don't get out much, so it's nice.
That means a lot to me. You make life brighter, even when things get tough. Speaking of which, can I be honest with you about something that's happened?
Of course, you can tell me anything. Is everything okay?

I wasn't going to burden you, but I feel like I can trust you. My mom had a medical emergency today and I had to cover her hospital bill. I tried to pay but my bank account got locked due to some 'suspicious activity.' I'm honestly panicking.
Oh no, I'm so sorry. That sounds terrible. Is she alright? Are you okay?

She's stable now, thank God. But the hospital won't release her until I pay the balance. I've already tried everything, called my bank, but they're saying it could take days to resolve. I hate asking, but... could you help me, just until my account is back?
I... I want to help, just let me know what you need. How much is it?
It's $1,200. I promise I'll pay you back as soon as my account is unlocked. I just don't know who else to turn to. You're really the only one I trust.
Okay, I'll see what I can do. What's the best way to send it?
Could you send it to my Venmo? My username is @james-lin-82. Or if it's easier, I can send you my bank details so you can do a transfer. Whatever works for you.
I think Venmo is easiest for me. Are you sure this is safe? I just want to make sure you get it.
Absolutely, it's totally safe. I use Venmo all the time, and it's instant. You're doing me such a huge favor, I can't thank you enough.
Alright, I'll send it right now. Please let me know as soon as you get it.
Of course, I'll be waiting and let you know immediately. You have no idea how much this means to me. I feel so lucky to have met you.
I'm just glad I can help. I really hope your mom gets better soon.
Thank you, truly. I'll keep you updated. And as soon as my bank unlocks, I'll make sure to pay you back. You're honestly amazing.
I trust you. Just let me know if you need anything else, okay?
